parameters.query:
-- 原子领取 1 条 SCRIPT_READY 任务，避免多个工作流同时处理同一条。
-- 领取后状态改为 MEDIA_READY：在本方案里表示“已进入素材/渲染阶段”。

WITH picked AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM video_topics
  WHERE status = 'SCRIPT_READY'
  ORDER BY updated_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE video_topics AS v
SET
  status = 'MEDIA_READY',
  error = NULL,
  updated_at = NOW()
FROM picked
WHERE v.id = picked.id
RETURNING
  v.id::text AS id,
  v.topic,
  v.platform,
  v.style,
  v.duration_seconds,
  v.language,
  v.target_audience,
  v.title,
  v.hook,
  v.script,
  v.cover_text,
  v.hashtags,
  v.shots_json,
  v.risk_check,
  v.status,
  v.created_at,
  v.updated_at;

-- Worker 成功生成视频后，把任务推进到 NEED_REVIEW。
-- n8n Postgres 节点建议使用参数化查询。
-- 参数顺序：
-- $1 = cover_path
-- $2 = video_path
-- $3 = render_result JSON 字符串
-- $4 = id

UPDATE video_topics
SET
  cover_path = $1,
  video_path = $2,
  risk_check = COALESCE(risk_check, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('render_result', $3::jsonb),
  status = 'NEED_REVIEW',
  error = NULL,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $4::uuid
RETURNING
  id::text AS id,
  topic,
  title,
  cover_path,
  video_path,
  status,
  updated_at;

meta.description: MVP: 读取 SCRIPT_READY，调用 video-worker 生成 final.mp4/cover/subtitles，再回写 NEED_REVIEW。
